categories.main_business_segments: Pan-Pacific Co., Ltd. operates primarily in five business segments: apparel manufacturing and sales, down feather processing and sales, rice flour processing and sales, bedding manufacturing and sales, and real estate leasing. The apparel segment is the largest contributor, accounting for over 90% of total sales, followed by down feather products and real estate leasing. The company also engages in supporting services such as planning, accounting, and IT for subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes overseas production facilities in Vietnam, Indonesia, and Myanmar to leverage cost advantages and maintain competitiveness. It imports raw materials such as polyester, cotton, nylon, zippers, duck down, and goose down primarily from China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Vietnam. Pan-Pacific operates a Design & Technology Research Institute focused on original apparel design and new material development. The down feather processing involves strict quality control to meet advanced markets like Japan and Germany.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Pan-Pacific's primary customers are major global apparel brands including GAP, TARGET, and Columbia. The company serves the outdoor, casual, and sportswear markets, exporting mainly to the United States, Europe, Japan, and other international markets. The down feather products cater to premium bedding and cold-weather clothing sectors. The rice flour products target domestic food manufacturers, while real estate leasing serves commercial tenants in South Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases in Vietnam, Indonesia, Myanmar, China, India, and the United States. Its sales are predominantly export-oriented, with approximately 76% of revenue coming from overseas markets, especially the U.S. Domestic sales account for about 24%. Raw materials are sourced mainly from China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Vietnam. The headquarters and real estate assets are located in Seoul, South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: Pan-Pacific functions primarily as a midstream manufacturer and exporter in the apparel and down feather supply chains. It procures raw materials from upstream suppliers in Asia and processes them into finished goods through its overseas manufacturing subsidiaries. The company then sells these finished products downstream to global brand buyers and retailers. It also operates downstream in real estate leasing and rice flour processing sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in apparel design and new material development through its dedicated Design & Technology Research Institute. It focuses on enhancing manufacturing competitiveness via automation and overseas production to reduce costs. Strategic priorities include expanding global top-tier vendor status, diversifying product lines, and improving operational efficiency. The company also manages financial risks proactively and invests in product differentiation and quality enhancement.
categories.revenue_model: Pan-Pacific generates revenue primarily through the manufacturing and sale of apparel products under contract with global brand buyers. Additional revenue streams include sales of down feather products, rice flour, bedding products, and rental income from real estate assets. The company operates on a B2B model, fulfilling large orders from major international clients, with export sales constituting the majority of revenue. It also provides ancillary services such as IT and administrative support to subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the global apparel manufacturing industry, facing competition from other large-scale OEM/ODM vendors in Asia. It maintains a strong market position by securing orders from leading global brands and leveraging cost-effective overseas production. In the down feather and bedding markets, it holds a relatively high domestic market share with recognized quality. The company positions itself as a reliable, large-scale vendor with diversified product offerings and strong design capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the fiscal year ending 2023, Pan-Pacific reported consolidated revenues of approximately 920 billion KRW, with a 15% decline from the previous year due to inventory reductions by major buyers. Operating profit was 40.6 billion KRW, reflecting a decrease in profitability. The company has a total asset base of about 686 billion KRW and equity of 207 billion KRW. Despite recent challenges, it has reduced debt levels and aims for sustainable growth through new customer acquisition and enhanced manufacturing competitiveness.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Pan-Pacific offers unique value through its ability to deliver high-quality, original apparel designs and innovative materials tailored to global brand standards. Its competitive advantage lies in cost-efficient overseas production combined with strong design and technology capabilities. The company emphasizes product differentiation by expanding item categories beyond outdoor wear to include casual and formal apparel. Additionally, it leverages strict quality control in down feather processing and maintains stable supply chains for raw materials, ensuring reliability and customer satisfaction.
